newsitem.title: LEBANON: Car bomb kills pro-Israeli militiaman in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Car bomb kills pro-Israeli militiaman in Lebanon.

text.p: An officer in the pro-Israeli militia in south Lebanon was killed on Sunday by a car bomb blast, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

They said the blast occurred when 30-year-old Captain Asaad Nammour of the South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia stepped into his car outside his home in Jizzine, a strip of territory officially outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone but under SLA control.
No group claimed immediate responsibility for the attack.
Moslem Lebanese and leftist Arab guerrillas regularly attack Israeli troops and their local militia allies in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine miles)-wide occupation zone.
